generator_balance: prefer diversity without relaxing semantic or grammatical screening
screening: No score-based selection. Native epistemic uncertainty only, same claim and one target sentence. Exclude permission/ability, negations/conditional scopes, quoted material, redundant-only removal and unrelated modifications. Whole source triplet may be replaced before NLI for an unambiguous grammatical or semantic failure, using same-domain reserved sources; preserve audit trail.
review: Score-blind assistant reading of selected source triplets before inference; not human gold. Prepare independent blank human forms. Record valid/qualified/invalid and uncertainty, retain full intended-label analysis and matched valid-review subset separately.
nli_backend: same validated non-quantized ONNX export; native PyTorch reference verification, existing pipeline
document_support: min(nli_forward_min,nli_reverse_min); per unit maximum entailment over top3 retrieved evidence
alteration_risk: negative document_support; not one minus support
primary_metric: document-level AUC against faithful positive controls, and sensitivity/FPR at fixed historical threshold
local_scores: secondary directional/local AUC and distributions only; do not transfer document threshold to local score
uncertainty: pointwise percentile 95% source-group bootstrap, all variants of each original kept together; continuous AUC independent of decision threshold; class risk=altered
counting: report raw TP/FN/FP/TN and source-weighted class rates; counts of independent sources separately from variants
limitations: Generated conditions and assistant review do not constitute independent human semantic labels.
Partial strengthening and epistemic versus deontic readings depend on context.
Transfer of a frozen threshold is tested, not assumed; current window2 primary suite is unchanged.
No automatic extension to real humanizers; no repetition of BLEU/ROUGE/BERTScore or prior experiments.
secondary_rate_ci: Wilson 95% for sensitivity in full/partial subtypes and FPR only when exactly one evaluated variant per original source; never treat the 120 pooled alterations as independent for a binomial interval.
secondary_rate_ci_reason: Prespecified before any new NLI scores: ordinary source bootstrap rates can have degenerate intervals at zero or one events.
candidate_search_amendment: Before any NLI scoring, initial source search found only 51 independent eligible originals under a per-generator candidate cap that could count variants of the same source. Search now counts globally unique source groups, increases the computational cap to 20 per domain/generator and stops at 40 independent eligible candidates per domain. No grammatical/semantic filter, target count, random seed, label or NLI setting is relaxed.
native_pool_amendment: Before any new NLI inference: all 1976 eligible-marker records under the initial exclusion set were screened and yielded only 51 independent applicable originals (29 Essay, 14 WritingPrompts, 8 Reuters); no computational cap was responsible. Remove only the two stylometry-feature CSVs from source exclusions. Their feature extraction did not use semantic labels, NLI scores or threshold calibration. Retain all six previous semantic-panel exclusions, connected-source and canonical-text exclusions. Keep 60 sources, target 20/domain, 120 alterations, original seed, rules and NLI settings. Sources may have appeared in prior stylometry analyses; they are new to the previous declared semantic panels, not globally untouched texts.
grammatical_guard_amendment: Before any NLI inference, reject leading list bullets, finite verbs inside parser-derived subject subtrees, uncertain disjunctive subject agreement, and be-able ability constructions. Lower the article A inside preserved possibility wrappers. These conservative fixes do not broaden semantic eligibility or use scores.
domain_quota_amendment: Before NLI inference: expanded native screening found 82 independent eligible originals (40 Essay computational cap, 26 WritingPrompts, 16 Reuters). Keep 60 originals, 120 alterations and 60 faithful controls; balanced deterministic selection gives 22 Essay, 22 WritingPrompts and 16 Reuters. Treat 20/domain as preference, not requirement. No semantic/grammatical rule, threshold or model is changed. If textual review rejects a source and its same-domain reserve is exhausted, use the next deterministic score-blind reserve from another domain and log the replacement before inference.
